title: Module 3 model-comparison subtask (R12) results schema
description: Schema for the R12 subtask: pick one real, non-trivial source file with a genuine mix of issues, run the same structured review request against POST /code-review with each of the three named deployments, twice in a row per model on the identical file, and score each run per context/TICKET.md's stated method. This file is a scaffold only - as of Increment 8, no live DIAL/VPN run has been performed in this sandbox (see 03-code-review-agent/evaluation/RESULTS.md's R12 section), so every score/verdict field below is REQUIRES_OPERATOR or null rather than fabricated, per context/RETROSPECTIVE.md's standing honesty rule (do not attribute a review/score to a run that never happened). An operator completing this subtask should either fill in evaluation/runs/<timestamp>-model-comparison.json conforming to this schema, or extend this file directly, and update RESULTS.md's R12 section to cite the real artifact.

status.description: REQUIRES_OPERATOR until an operator with live DIAL/VPN access has actually performed all 6 runs (3 deployments x 2 runs each) and filled in every modelRuns[] entry's real verdict/score.

sourceFile.description: Repository-relative path to the single, real, non-trivial source file chosen for this subtask (the ticket permits taking it 'from any source'). Null until an operator selects one.

sourceFileModified.description: Always false: this subtask reviews an existing file's content as-is between the two runs per model; the file must not be edited between runs, or the two runs would no longer be a genuine same-input reliability comparison.

categories.description: The five structured-review categories the ticket's subtask requires, verbatim.

scoringMethod.description: Restates context/TICKET.md's own subtask analysis method, so this schema is self-describing without needing the ticket open side by side.

passRule.const: pass = net-accurate findings (every cited line/claim verified against the actual file)

failRule.const: fail = a new false claim not present in the model's other run

modelRuns.description: Exactly 6 entries: one per (deployment, runNumber) pair, 3 deployments x 2 runs each.

verdict.description: Null while status is PENDING. PASS/FAIL per scoringMethod above, decided only after every cited line/claim has been individually verified against sourceFile's real content.

findingsByCategory.description: One entry per category in `categories`, each an array of individually-verified finding summaries.

verifiedAgainstFile.description: True only once a human/reviewer has read sourceFile at citedLine and confirmed the claim is accurate; null while status is PENDING.

genericTemplatedClaimsFlagged.description: Claims that sound true for almost any class (getters/setters, encapsulation, documentation) but were specifically checked against this file rather than accepted on plausibility alone, per the ticket's own warning.

blindSpots.description: Real issues present in sourceFile that this run's model missed, building a cross-run/cross-model blind-spot list per the ticket's instruction.

reversedVerdicts.description: Populated only once both runs for a given deployment are COMPLETED: any deployment whose two runs produced a different PASS/FAIL verdict on the same file is a reliability flag on its own, per the ticket's own instruction, regardless of which run was more accurate.
